gao-gaoreports-gao-08-286t: GAO briefed Congress in 2007 on its bag of spy tricks: secret shoppers, fake job seekers, and staged scams used to test federal programs. These secret runs caught weak locks and crooked claims that plain audits missed. The briefing makes the case for bold test work — and shows, case by case, how posing as the bad guy kept public money safe.
gao-gaoreports-gao-08-226t: In 2007 testimony, the Government Accountability Office told Congress the Small Business Administration's 7(a) loan program needed more performance measures. The 7(a) program guarantees loans that help small firms borrow when banks won't lend on their own. GAO found SBA could not fully judge the program's effectiveness and recommended metrics that would show whether taxpayer backing was producing results.
gao-gaoreports-gao-08-126t: One year after Congress passed the SAFE Port Act, this 2007 Government Accountability Office testimony checks how port-security reforms were being implemented. The law ordered tougher cargo screening, new technology, and better coordination at America's seaports. GAO reports on what had actually been put in place and where implementation was lagging behind the law's ambitions.
gao-gaoreports-gao-08-216t: This 2007 Government Accountability Office testimony examines how aircraft noise affects communities near airports — and how that noise constrains airport operations and the growth of the national air system. GAO lays out the tension between neighbors' quality of life and aviation's expansion. The testimony frames noise as a real policy problem, not just a nuisance, shaping where and how airports can grow.
gao-gaoreports-gao-08-146t: GAO stunned Congress in 2007 with tales from teen boot camps: kids hurt and even killed in private lock-up programs for troubled youth. State and federal eyes on the trade were half-shut, GAO found. The briefing helped crack open a shadow industry — one that sold tough love to desperate parents with almost no one checking the bruises.
gao-gaoreports-gao-08-96t: GAO warned Congress in 2007 that the farm-gate guards were slipping: the port and border checks that keep foreign bugs off U.S. crops and herds. Thin running of the quarantine program, GAO said, left billion-dollar harvests exposed. The briefing spotlights a farm-security gap hiding behind the bigger border debates.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-1256t: Wounded troops faced a paper maze to get care and benefits in 2007 — and GAO gave Congress an early look at the fix-up job. The briefing previews findings on the Pentagon and VA's joint effort to smooth health handoffs and injury ratings. It reads now as the warning flare before the scandal broke wide open.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-1246t: The VA's computer empire was a patchwork of local kingdoms in 2007, and GAO told Congress the merger into one system was half-done. Progress, yes — but the hard parts lingered. The briefing blames the stall on thin follow-through at the top, not on the wires themselves.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-1106t: The 2010 headcount was already wobbling in 2007 — GAO's briefing says census prep was underway but the watch could not blink. The testimony demands relentless oversight and risk control. The findings frame the count as a mission already behind: no do-overs on census day.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-1016t: The Forest Service's tree-cutting shortcut drew GAO's eye in 2007 — the briefing examines vegetation projects waved through under categorical exclusions. The testimony questions whether the fast lane fit the forest. The findings pit efficiency against the public's right to weigh in on public lands.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-806t: The Trade Center's indoor poisons got a second look in 2007 — GAO's briefing offers early notes on the EPA's follow-up cleanup program. The testimony previews the findings on dust and air. The briefing keeps the health questions open where New Yorkers breathed.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-926t: Colleges serving the underserved got a closer look in 2007 — GAO's briefing says the Education Department had stepped up its watch and help for low-income and minority schools. The testimony tracks the progress. The findings ask whether the attention reached the campuses that needed it most.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-896t: Taxing the internet stayed frozen in 2007 — GAO's briefing says the moratorium's revenue hit would land unevenly across states. The testimony maps the winners and losers. The findings fed the fight over whether the web should stay a tax-free zone.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-856t: Dangerous pills were slipping through in 2007 — GAO's briefing says the FDA needed to sharpen how it decided on drug risks after approval. The testimony targets the postmarket blind spot. The findings argue that the safety watch cannot end at the pharmacy counter.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-826t: Kids' dental care under Medicaid was a data desert in 2007 — GAO's briefing says the numbers were too thin to oversee the program. The testimony demands better teeth in the data. The findings argue you cannot fix what you cannot count, especially children's smiles.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-746t: The Northern Marianas were in deep trouble in 2007 — GAO's briefing walks through the territory's economic, fiscal, and accountability woes in full. The testimony paints the crisis in stark detail for Congress. The findings ask what Washington truly owed its struggling Pacific commonwealth in the long run.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-596t: The Pentagon's spy-tech shopping needed focus in 2007 — GAO's briefing offers early notes on how requirements were being managed. The testimony previews the coming findings. The message is blunt: buy the eyes the war needs, not the toys the vendors sell.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-646t: Kids learning English were the testing frontier in 2007 — GAO's briefing says better federal help could let states track their progress well. The testimony targets the measurement gap. The findings argue that the left-behind law should leave no learner uncounted.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-656t: The Joint Strike Fighter's second engine got a price check in 2007 — GAO's briefing analyzes the costs of the alternate-engine program. The testimony does the math in public. The findings ask whether the backup motor was truly worth its billions.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-636t: The FAA's next act needed a steady director in 2007 — GAO's briefing flags the key issues for building the future system safely. The testimony lists the challenges in detail. The findings warn that the agency guiding the planes needed firmer guidance itself.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-616t: American food aid was tangled in red tape in 2007 — GAO's briefing says the agencies faced real hurdles to making it efficient. The testimony lists the knots in detail. The findings ask whether the grain reached the hungry or the middlemen.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-626t: The nation's critical arteries stayed exposed in 2007 — GAO's briefing says protecting the key sectors still faced real challenges. The testimony surveys the vulnerabilities in detail. The findings warn that the power grid and water plants were one bad day from headlines.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-606t: Wounded troops were falling through the cracks in 2007, and GAO's briefing traces the challenges injured servicemembers faced during recovery. The testimony follows their ordeal step by step. The findings demand that the system serve the wounded as well as they served.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-566t: The airlift and tanker fleets faced hard questions in 2007, and GAO's briefing lays out the issues around the cargo and refueling programs. The testimony previews the coming fights. The findings warn that the flying gas stations were aging out fast.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-576t: Electronic voting was a national headache in 2007, and GAO's briefing says every level of government had to help fix the challenges. The testimony spreads the duty wide and far. The findings warn that democracy's machines cannot run on good intentions alone.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-556t: The federal workforce was aging out in 2007, and GAO's briefing frames the human-capital challenges of the new century. The testimony sounds the demographic alarm loudly. The findings warn that the government's brain trust was heading for the exits. The retirement wave was already breaking.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-426t: Rebuilding Iraq was stalling in 2007, and GAO's briefing says contracting snarls, security woes, and capacity gaps blocked the progress. The testimony lists the obstacles. The findings warn that the reconstruction was drowning in its own complications. The rebuilding was running on fumes.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-446t: The Coast Guard's Deepwater fleet was troubled in 2007, and GAO's briefing offers early notes on the assets and management strains. The testimony previews the problems. The findings warn that the cutters of tomorrow were being built on shaky ground. The sea service deserved sounder ships.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-436t: The Northern Marianas were in deep trouble in 2007, and GAO's briefing walks through the territory's economic, fiscal, and accountability woes. The testimony paints the crisis. The findings ask what Washington owed its struggling Pacific commonwealth. The Pacific territory was running out of time.
gao-gaoreports-gao-07-386t: Spending security dollars wisely needed a method in 2007, and GAO's briefing says risk principles should guide the federal investments. The testimony makes the case. The findings argue that the scariest threats should get the first dollars. The math had to follow the menace.
